title: Bare 'menu' returns the full menu with prices

expected.notes: Every category must be present with real prices — this is the canonical explicit menu trigger.

title: 'menu please' returns the full menu with prices

expected.notes: Locks the original menu-intro-only regression fix: this exact phrasing used to get an intro line with zero items.

title: 'full menu' returns the full menu with prices
'show menu' returns the full menu with prices
'view menu' returns the full menu with prices
'kya kya hai' returns the full menu with prices

expected.notes: Roman Urdu reduplication idiom for 'what all do you have' — must be recognized as a full-menu request.

title: 'kia kia available hai' returns the full menu with prices

expected.notes: Alternate spelling of kya kya hai, plus 'available' — must still resolve to the full menu.

title: 'pizza menu dikhao' shows ONLY the Pizza category

expected.notes: A specific category word always wins over the bare 'menu' mention in the same message — only that category's real items should appear.

title: 'burgers dikhao' shows ONLY the Burgers category
'pasta menu batao' shows ONLY the Pasta category
Full menu, then a follow-up category request narrows correctly

expected.notes: A follow-up category-scoped request after the full menu must still correctly narrow to just that category.

title: An untaught menu phrasing still gets the real, priced menu (backstop preserved)
messages: hey what do you guys offer around here

expected.notes: The menu-intro-only backstop exists specifically to catch phrasings the trigger-word list hasn't been taught yet — this must keep working even after the greeting-exclusion fix.
